job_function: client lifecycle management - trading documentation control
control_point: Derivatives trading documentation, including ISDA Master Agreement, Credit Support Annex, GMRA and GMSLA and adherence to ISDA protocols, is executed, captured and verified before trades are booked; the control point is the existence of a valid, executed legal framework with the counterparty and any required protocol adherence.

citations.source_name: CFTC Regulation 23.501 – Swap trading relationship documentation

consequence_anchor.public_source: CFTC/SEC swap-trading-relationship-documentation rules and ESMA/FCA conduct requirements for derivatives documentation
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: per-counterparty or per-trade supervisory penalties and mandatory remediation; larger fines for systematic documentation gaps

commonality_rationale: Every swap dealer and in-scope derivatives counterparty must execute and maintain ISDA-style documentation and protocol adherence before transacting; the requirement is independent of asset class or jurisdiction-specific booking.
